General IEEE journal graphics guidance; individual journals may add requirements.

## Rules

| Rule ID | Strength | Phases | Probe | Assertion |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `figure.width.single` | required | live, file | `artifact.width_mm` | approx `88.9` mm |
| `figure.width.double` | required | live, file | `artifact.width_mm` | approx `181.864` mm |
| `font.size.target` | inferred | live | `font.size.max_pt` | eq `8` pt |
| `line.width.min` | inferred | live | `line.width.min_pt` | gte `0.5` pt |
| `color.grayscale.distinguishable` | recommended | live | `color.non_color_distinctions` | eq `True` |
| `export.formats.vector` | required | file | `artifact.format` | in `pdf, eps` |
| `export.formats.halftone` | inferred | file | `artifact.format` | in `tiff, jpeg, png` |
| `export.formats.combination` | inferred | file | `artifact.format` | in `tiff, pdf` |
| `export.formats.line_art` | recommended | file | `artifact.format` | in `pdf, eps, tiff` |
| `export.min_dpi.halftone` | required | file | `artifact.dpi` | gte `300` dpi |
| `export.min_dpi.combination` | required | file | `artifact.dpi` | gte `300` dpi |
| `export.min_dpi.line_art` | required | file | `artifact.dpi` | gte `600` dpi |
